Império Médio (c. 2055–1750 a.C.):
Marcado pela expansão e subsequente cessão de poder aos hicsos.
Império Novo (c. 1550–1070 a.C.):
A era de grandes faraós como Ramsés II, onde o Egito atingiu sua maior expansão.
Fim da civilização unificada (31 a.C.):
O Egito, após um período de declínio, foi conquistado pelos romanos, encerrando sua independência como império.

text: Hamlet - To be, or not to be, that is the question; whether it be nobler in the soul To suffer the slings and arrows of foul fortune, Or to take arms against a sea of ​​adversities, And, by opposing them, put an end to them.
description_end: The line you quote is the beginning of Hamlet's most famous monologue, written by William Shakespeare around 1600. The passage confronts the existential question of whether to accept the suffering of life or end it through death. It is a fundamental text of world literature, where Shakespeare condenses the tension between action and inaction, life and death, courage and fear of the unknown.

text: Filled with deceit, they left an immense wooden horse before our walls, feigning an offering to Minerva. The Trojans, trusting, brought it into the city. That night, hidden in its belly, the Greeks emerged, set it ablaze, and paved the way for the slaughter that brought Troy to an end.
